_meta.name: Chinese (Simplified)
_meta.notes: Machine-assisted translation, not yet reviewed by a native speaker: corrections welcome. Uses 您. Chinese has no plural inflection, so .one and .other forms are identical; lists join with 、. Names of screens in My account, the admin console and the Cloudflare dashboard stay in English because those screens are English.
